interpretation_limits: After PR59, the new branch evidence variants were designed using known PR54-PR59 outcomes; exploratory, not independent confirmatory algorithm superiority.
Only custom hierarchical Branin/Rosenbrock mathematical tasks; not aircraft or a standardized benchmark replica.
All six arms genuinely made six new evaluations and refit using OWN already observed history; each arm may select different designs.
The legacy completion factor was one-class in PR45 aircraft, but non-aircraft task structure differs; treat ablation as a policy change, not a universal probability theorem.
The new Beta(1,1) discrete-branch posterior mean/standard deviation is a risk-uncertainty HEURISTIC under adaptive non-IID selections, not a calibrated credible or safety bound.
A no-acceptable-candidate information fallback may deliberately select high-risk designs; must report its observed failures, not pretend to enforce the allowance.
The old risk proxy is optimistic in PR59. Any improved score must be demonstrated on NEW real trajectories with identical calls.
The stop cap of six cannot truncate BEFORE the sixth call; that fact is not a safety guarantee.
Results are stratified by case, including all paired infeasible and only-one-feasible seeds; no unsupported p-value or cross-case pooling.
No mission-scale 140 km independent sparsity qualification or RCAIDE/flying vehicle validation.

method_definition.branch_dispersion: same but Beta mean+one posterior standard deviation
method_definition.branch_explore: branch_dispersion with explicit high-uncertainty fallback if no candidate passes
method_definition.branch_mean: GP risk upper-envelope with Beta(1,1) mean by discrete branch

plan.predeclared_primary_metric: paired feasible-first wins/losses/ties at six true online calls for each registered risk-UQ ablation
predeclared_secondary_metrics: paired objective delta only where both have known feasible exact values
pairwise real nonfeasible count difference at six charged calls
new feasible discovery when shared initial set is all nonfeasible
branch posterior mean/dispersion receipts from same-arm earlier outcomes
fallback failure rate and scored-forecast-vs-realized failure gap
